projects.title: Lean AI Ops
projects.description: A Python/Streamlit DMAIC project wizard and analytics workbench. Its public web interface explains the workflow but does not run the assessment engine.
projects.detail: The browser interface is deterministic; assessment generation, calculations and saved projects require the Python application.

projects.title: Everything Program Management
projects.description: Program-management skills, templates and fictional examples for charters, risk reviews and decisions, plus a CLI validating RAID records and decision-memo structure.
projects.detail: The CLI validates selected artifact fields, not the quality of a real-world program decision.

projects.title: Automotive LLM Eval Harness
projects.description: A prototype scorer for supplied synthetic in-cabin assistant cases, with reproducibility manifests and illustrative safety and privacy gates.
projects.detail: Scores supplied case files; it neither generates model responses nor independently evaluates a deployed assistant.

projects.title: AI Release Validator
projects.description: A Python CLI that validates the structure and internal consistency of AI release-decision records, including hard gates, conditions and evidence references.
projects.detail: Checks the supplied record. It does not verify the evidence, determine applicable controls or certify release readiness.

projects.title: Agent Evaluation Framework
projects.description: An evaluation-report schema, semantic validator and methodology for defining test coverage, measurement validity and release-decision rules.
projects.detail: A practitioner framework with fictional examples, not a benchmark or a claim of production evaluation coverage.

projects.title: AI Governance Playbook
projects.description: An operating-model playbook for AI decision rights, proportional review, evidence requirements, exceptions and lifecycle oversight.
projects.detail: Practitioner guidance for designing governance; not a compliance certificate or ready-made organizational policy.

projects.title: Agent System Simulator
projects.description: Runnable Python scenarios showing bounded retries, evidence-based acceptance, fallback contracts and human escalation.
projects.detail: Deterministic fixtures demonstrate control flow; they are not measurements of deployed multi-agent systems.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Governance
projects.description: A framework for defining agent and tool authority, instruction propagation controls, containment and recovery across delegated workflows.
projects.detail: Practitioner patterns; they do not enforce permissions or provide a running security boundary.

projects.title: AI Prism
projects.description: A curated index of AI governance sources, risk frameworks, evaluation tools, incident-response references and related research.
projects.detail: A reference hub with inclusion standards and review notes; it does not endorse or validate every linked tool.

projects.title: Prompt Harness Translator
projects.description: A CLI that translates supported Markdown/YAML prompt assets into Codex, Cursor and generic formats, flagging metadata that cannot map cleanly.
projects.detail: Limited format translation, not cross-runtime behavioral equivalence. Generated assets require human review.

projects.title: MCP & Agent Risk Checklist
projects.description: A review toolkit for MCP servers and agent integrations covering authority, data reach, tool invocation, containment and recovery.
projects.detail: A structured review aid, not a server scanner or declaration that an integration is secure.

projects.title: NIST AI RMF Guide
projects.description: An unofficial NIST AI RMF practitioner guide with scoped review questions, gap-assessment templates and evidence-status distinctions.
projects.detail: Not official NIST guidance; completing its templates does not establish implementation or compliance.
